zadanie:
Find the minimum value of
\[17 \log_{30} x - 3 \log_x 5 + 20 \log_x 15 - 3 \log_x 6 + 20 \log_x 2\]for $x > 1.$
oczekiwana_odpowiedz:
We can write
\begin{align*}
&17 \log_{30} x - 3 \log_x 5 + 20 \log_x 15 - 3 \log_x 6 + 20 \log_x 2 \\
&= 17 \log_{30} x - \log_x 5^3 + \log_x 15^{20} - \log_x 6^3 + \log_x 2^{20} \\
&= 17 \log_{30} x + \log_x \frac{15^{20} \cdot 2^{20}}{5^3 \cdot 6^3} \\
&= 17 \log_{30} x + \log_x (2^{17} \cdot 3^{17} \cdot 5^{17}) \\
&= 17 \log_{30} x + 17 \log_x 30 \\
&= 17 \left( \log_{30} x + \frac{1}{\log_{30} x} \right).
\end{align*}By AM-GM,
\[\log_{30} x + \frac{1}{\log_{30} x} \ge 2,\]so $17 \left( \log_{30} x + \frac{1}{\log_{30} x} \right) \ge 34.$  Equality occurs when $x = 30,$ so the minimum value is $\boxed{34}.$

Let's simplify the argument of the logarithm:
\[ \frac{15^{20} \cdot 2^{20}}{5^3 \cdot 6^3} = \frac{(3 \cdot 5)^{20} \cdot 2^{20}}{5^3 \cdot (2 \cdot 3)^3} = \frac{3^{20} \cdot 5^{20} \cdot 2^{20}}{5^3 \cdot 2^3 \cdot 3^3} = 3^{17} \cdot 5^{17} \cdot 2^{17} = (3 \cdot 5 \cdot 2)^{17} = 30^{17} \]
So the expression becomes:
\[ f(x) = 17 \log_{30} x + \log_x (30^{17}) \]
Using the property $\log_x (30^{17}) = 17 \log_x 30$, we have:
\[ f(x) = 17 \log_{30} x + 17 \log_x 30 \]

\[ f(u) = 17u + \frac{17}{u} \]

\[ \frac{u + \frac{1}{u}}{2} \ge \sqrt{u \cdot \frac{1}{u}} = 1 \implies u + \frac{1}{u} \ge 2 \]
The equality holds when $u = \frac{1}{u}$, which means $u^2 = 1$, and since $u > 0$, $u = 1$.

\[ 17(2) = 34 \]
